stem: Which statement best explains one effect of the New Deal?

options.label: F
options.text: The federal government took control of public education and universities.

options.label: G
options.text: Corporations had to obtain permission from state governments before hiring workers.

options.label: H
options.text: Labor unions had to provide justification to state governments before conducting strikes.

options.label: J
options.text: People relied more on the federal government for assistance.
